items.title: Hackers Hijack Five OVHcloud CLI Releases to Distribute Secret-Stealing Malware
items.summary: An attacker used a contributor's GitHub account to replace the download archives on five existing releases of OVHcloud's command-line tool on Monday, October 19. The account had been hijacked, and the new files were a build designed to steal secrets stored on the disk of any machine that runs it, the cloud provider says.
